context_summary: F89 Batch Collection Management — LigaMagic-style batch add and edit. Currently the only way to add cards is CSV import (destructive re-import) and there are no edit endpoints for qty/condition/language/extras. This feature adds: (1) Batch Add with text parser (Qty CardName [Set] [Condition] [Language] [Extras]), preview table, POST endpoint; (2) Batch Edit with multi-select checkboxes, bulk actions toolbar (qty, condition, language, extras, delete), PATCH endpoint; (3) Single Card inline edit on detail/tile pages. Well-scoped CRUD feature with clear data model.

options_considered.description: Proceed with plan-feature for F89 — full batch collection management.
pros: Clear user need — no edit or non-destructive add mechanism exists
Data model already supports all fields (qty, quality, language, extras)
Follows established LigaMagic UX pattern users are familiar with
cons: Text parser needs robust error handling

options_considered.description: Split into F89 (single edit) + F90 (batch add) + F91 (batch edit).
cons: Shared backend (PATCH endpoint) would be duplicated across plans

rationale: Single feature with parallel waves. Backend PATCH/POST endpoints are shared across all three use cases. The text parser, multi-select UI, and inline edit are independent frontend work that can run in parallel waves. No reason to split.
